name: Antigravity Remote Control & Hub
description: Installs Google Antigravity via the official CLI installer with support for Google Remote Control (antigravity.google) and local Ingress Hub.

enableRemoteControl.description: Enable outbound Google cloud proxy tunnel for access via antigravity.google

enableLocalInterface.description: Enable local Web UI hub server on hubPort (default 52424) for internal Ingress / LAN access

hubPort.description: Port to serve the local Web UI hub on (defaults to 52424 to match Kubernetes Ingress bridge)

hostname.description: Custom instance nickname for this devcontainer in the antigravity.google dashboard
